query:
SELECT
               trial_ever_granted,
               manual_plan_id,
               (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - first_login_at::timestamptz)) / 3600.0)::float8 AS hours_since
           FROM streamer_plans
           WHERE TRIM(COALESCE(twitch_user_id,'')) = $1
              OR LOWER(COALESCE(twitch_login,'')) = LOWER($2)
           LIMIT 1
